verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a public REST API with a published OpenAPI spec covering syncs, models, sources and destinations, plus an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant manage and create syncs. That covers programmatic pipeline management and wiring syncs. The evidence does not explicitly show agents creating sources and destinations, or inspecting sync-run deliveries, through the API or MCP; run reporting and debugging appear only as product features. Missing for 10: explicit documented create endpoints or MCP tools for sources and destinations, documented API or MCP access to sync-run and delivery inspection, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can manage the pipeline itself — create sources and destinations, wire streams, inspect deliveries — through a documented API or MCP server
